name: AITooltip
description: AITooltip is the AI-styled counterpart of the DS Tooltip system for AI surfaces (cards, drawers, generated dashboards). It is a re-skin, not a re-implementation: the tooltip / popover geometry, CSS border-triangle arrow math, size scale (Normal 16px / Small 14px), arrow directions (top / bottom / left / right) and positions (start / center / end), and the popover section structure are all ported verbatim from the DS Tooltip building blocks.
intent: The DS Tooltip in AI clothing — same border-triangle arrows and popover geometry, AI brand indigo footer/confirmation buttons, and AI-softened corners (6px tooltips, 16px cards).

authority.note: Imported from godesign27/agentic-ui-design-system (branch cursor/import-ai-components-6d77). Runtime TSX lives under src/components/ai/. Existing top-level shadcn ports remain authoritative for the governed AI kit.
